description: This file defines the CurrencyType entity class used in the OrangeHRM system, representing currency types with properties like code, id, and name. It uses Doctrine ORM annotations for database mapping and includes relationships to PayGradeCurrency entities.

classes.name: CurrencyType
classes.description: Entity class representing a currency type with ORM mappings, properties for code, id, name, and a collection of related pay grade currencies.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Returns the numerical code of the currency type.

methods.name: setCode
methods.description: Sets the numerical code for the currency type.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the currency.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the currency.
